model.name: parallax scroll
model.description: As the user scrolls down the page, layered content panels move at different visual depths, revealing subsequent sections beneath or sliding over prior ones. The initial yellow section with stat numbers and an image scrolls upward to unveil a monochrome portrait section, followed by content cards sliding into view.
model.how_to_implement: Use GSAP ScrollTrigger to tie element transforms directly to the scrollbar position (`scrub: true`), or use modern CSS `position: sticky` with stacked layers and `@scroll-timeline` / `animation-timeline: scroll()` for native scroll-linked parallax animations.
